notes.title: Cat N Can now On steam!!!
notes.notes:
hi everyone,
our new game, Cat N Can, now on steam, it is a 3d puzzle crossover card game.
You are the cat goint to find a can. The Card is define the way you walk. In the way to find you will meet many animal, some will help you some will scare you. Everything in the map are reactable, use everything on map and card to help the cat find can!
hope you love my game and follower also wishlist it!![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42944479/1755f94603ba3591eded708d8e927fc7a6591da0.png[/img]

notes.title: The Cat Maze Now Released, First Week Have 20% off discount
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Thanks for all the wishlists and support for The Cat Maze , it means a lot.
I started working on The Cat Maze of light 1 years ago and as a solo developer, releasing is the end of a rich journey. I hope my work will please you !

The launch are already uploaded
The sell price will be $4.99.
It will have a launch discount of 20% for a first week. That means you will be able to get it at $3.99, youhou !



The goal I have is to make the game available in english and chinese, it will be more language later . The store page in these languages should all be online . The game should be translated upon release in these languages.

If you'd like to see the game in your language, feel free to ask :)

Have a great day
See you soon
Indigo Game Production
